branch.warning: The inventory record for this returned, firmware-locked device says it must go through a secure wipe and QA, in the words "require secure wipe & QA before returning to sale." Setting its quantity to 1 puts it back on sale without any sign that those steps were done. This changes the quantity of item 60071 from 0 to 1, so the store will show the unwiped returned serialized module (locked to SN-60071) as available for sale. With item 60071 now showing quantity 1, a later inventory update on the same item could build on this availability, so the unwiped, unchecked device could be sold or its stock count adjusted further.
